youtube_title: Reder Road in Griffith: the hitchhiker legend of Northwest Indiana (viewer request)
body: You asked for Griffith! Reder Road once ran a few miles through the woods toward Merrillville; its east end has been gated off for decades. Legend says a young woman named Elizabeth Wilson was in a car that went off the road in the 1950s, into a swamp, and never made it home, and that she still walks the road looking for a ride, vanishing near Ross Cemetery. Others report a dark figure by the railroad tracks, sometimes carrying a lantern. But the Ghost Research Society says it found no burial record for an Elizabeth Wilson at Ross Cemetery. Part of Reder Road is a neighborhood street: please respect residents, gates and posted signs. 🚗 Comment your town, and it could be next! #Griffith #LakeCounty #NWI #Indiana #UrbanLegend #LaPorteAfterDark
